notes:
- Edit underlay for an entire Satin or Tatami branch in one step. Select a single component to edit it independently.
- Use Design > Routing > Toggle Branch Underlay First to sew support before the top stitches. The engine takes shorter routes between support passes where the design can cover the travel and keeps sewn travel out of cutouts.
- Add Double Tatami underlay to Tatami and closed Satin fills. Set the spacing and angle of two perpendicular passes from one layer in the Underlay panel.
